* '''Playtest''' ([[Mitth'raw'nuruodo (Playtest)]], 12 May 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 12 May 2019: [[:File:V11-D-mitthrawnuruodo-20190512.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/948e819/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/mitthrawnuruodo.gif Holotable commit 948e819 “Fixed Dash in Rogue 12 and Getting Pretty Good at This”]), no mark. Text: “[Pilot] 3. Once per turn, may target a related location; opponent loses 1 Force the next time they move to that location this turn. May lose 1 Force to cancel a just-drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting. Thrawn's game text may not be canceled.”
* '''Playtest 2''' ([[Mitth'raw'nuruodo (Playtest 2)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-mitthrawnuruodo-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/mitthrawnuruodo.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “[Pilot] 3. Once per turn, may target a related location; opponent loses 1 Force the next time they move to that location this turn. May lose 1 Force to cancel a just-drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting. Thrawn's game text may not be canceled.” '''What changed:''' new artwork (Thrawn with a stormtrooper helmet, image courtesy of Diah Mot; the 12 May 2019 image showed Thrawn in a white uniform with the Decipher copyright line), and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; same words. (Later on 1 August 2019 the file was removed (Holotable commit 25765fc “Removing old Thrawn image”) and re-added on release day.)
* '''Original''' (this page, 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-mitthrawnuruodo-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/mitthrawnuruodo.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “[Pilot] 3. Once per turn, may target a related location; opponent loses 1 Force the next time they move to that location this turn. May lose 1 Force to cancel a just-drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting. Thrawn's game text may not be canceled.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; same words.

Text: “[Pilot] 3. Once per turn, may target a related location; opponent loses 1 Force the next time they move to that location this turn. May lose 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting. Thrawn's game text may not be canceled.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: “a just-drawn weapon destiny” became “a just drawn weapon destiny” (hyphen dropped); re-rendered at high resolution.
